'''Voreclaw''' were a species of large insectoid bipeds living on Medriaas. Taller than an average [[Human/Legends|Human]] and protected by large chitinous shells, they were able to sustain themselves on both plant and animal life. As a semi-sentient species, they lived underground, where they formed colonies linked by the hive mind. The species nearly went extinct - in fact the voreclaw living deep underground remained the only things alive on the planet - in [[4999 BBY]], when a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] named [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]] performed the [[Ritual of Nathema]] that granted him immortality while stripping the Force from the entire planet, transforming Medriaas into a barren and lifeless world known as [[Nathema]]. However, the voreclaw hive mind was obliterated by the ritual, leaving their underground colonies nothing more than groups of mindless individuals. When the voreclaws, driven by hunger, finally emerged onto the surface, radiation from [[Nathema's sun]] ravaged the insects, burning their exposed flesh and their chitinous shells. In the utter absence of any other food, the creatures were forced into cannibalism, attacking and eating each other until only a handful remained. Vitiate eventually captured the few remaining survivors and stored them in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] beneath the [[Sanitarium]], using them as guards for generations as he needed.<ref name="Codex" /> Several voreclaw were encountered and killed by [[Lana Beniko]] and [[Alliance Commander|the Alliance Commander]] when they took shelter in the [[Emperor's Vaults|Emperor's Vault]] beneath the Sanitarium in [[3630 BBY]].<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]''</ref>

After life returned to Nathema sometime after 3630 BBY, voreclaws were observed to be living wild on the planet along with new generations of juveniles.<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Voreclaw.jpg|thumb|left|100px|Voreclaw on Tatooine]]Voreclaw appear in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' '''Chapter 7: Into the Void'''. Players can also obtain a Voreclaw companion and a Voreclaw corpse housing decoration from Cartel Market packs.
